notes.title: Minor Update: Localization & Exit Fix
notes.content: [p]Hello, brave souls who have chosen to sail the sea![/p][p][b]This small update brings community-suggested fixes to improve your experience.[/b] [b]Credits and language have been polished, and the game will no longer close at the end of your journey.[/b][/p][p]Thank you for your continued feedback and support! 🐟[/p]

notes.title: 🎣 The Chosen Catch - WINNER ANNOUNCEMENT!
notes.content:
[p]After a flood of incredible entries and some tough deliberation by our jury, we're excited to announce the winner of [i]The Chosen Catch[/i] creative contest!!! [/p][p]🏆 [b]Ksenoforiya[/b] [i](Carlos_The_Cockroach on Steam)

[/i]Give them a follow and show some love for their incredible work on [url="https://www.tumblr.com/ksenoforiya"]Tumblr[/url] or [url="https://x.com/_KsenofonitA_"]X[/url]![i]
  [/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587774/7b12c17b4ee8601c57ba8b92a8448e7c7fc224fb.png"][/img][i]  [/i] 
We’re proud to feature it as our profile picture !!

[/p][hr][/hr][p]

👉 See all the amazing entries in our [b]gallery here:[/b] [url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OmH5DzGRrP31tDZLLUf2Q-quzIeBw8YW?usp=sharing"]Google Drive gallery[/url]
[/p][p]We were so happy to see each and every one of your creations - every single piece meant a lot to us. 💙[/p][p][b]Thank you for being part of it![/b][/p]

notes.title: 🎣 The Chosen Catch - CREATIVE CONTEST
notes.content:
[p]Have you met a fish so strange and captivating it stayed with you long after the tide returned? [/p][p][b]Share a drawing, edit or creation[/b] [b]of the most endearing creature[/b] you've pulled from the sea in our demo. Add a hat or ribbon? Let your fish have its moment in the spotlight! [/p][list][*][p][i][b]Please ensure all entries are handmade. AI-generated content is not eligible for this contest.[/b][/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]
We’ll choose one winner[/b] whose art will be [b]featured as our profile pic for a month[/b] - plus a [b]big shoutout[/b] to celebrate their catch![b]
[/b]
[b]🗓️ The contest closes at the end of the Fishing Festival on June 23rd.[/b][/p][p][b]🎨 Cast your entry now!


[/b][/p][p][/p][p]🖼️ To enter, we originally asked for uploads to the “Artwork” section of our Steam Community Hub - [b]but it seems that’s currently not working for some players, especially in the demo version.


[/b]
So we’re now collecting all entries in a public [url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OmH5DzGRrP31tDZLLUf2Q-quzIeBw8YW?usp=sharing"]Google Drive gallery[/url] instead!

[/p][hr][/hr][p]📬 [b]How to participate:[/b]
Send your artwork to [/p][p][url="https://liquidsquid.help@gmail.com"]liquidsquid.help@gmail.com[/url][/p][p]
- Include your [b]name or username[/b] so we can credit you![/p]

notes.title: Mourning Tide DEMO is live!!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]After the unexpected viral success of our first version, and thanks to all the wonderful people who played it and believed the journey was worth continuing, we're excited to share the [b]brand new demo of [i]Mourning Tide[/i][/b], now available on Steam!
[/p][p][i][b]Mourning Tide[/b][/i] is a first-person fishing horror game. You play as a guilt-ridden fisherman sailing into forbidden waters. With every catch, something stirs… memories, regrets, things best left beneath the waves.
[/p][p]This demo is the first act of the full tale, completely rebuilt, expanded, and improved from the original version. It offers its own ending for now, but the story is far from over. 
[/p][p]We’re deeply grateful for your support. Every wishlist, every bit of feedback, every soul who stops by the shore - it means the world to us. If you’re drawn to quiet horrors, forgotten depths, and stories that echo long after the last cast, you’re in the right waters.
[/p][p]Thanks for sailing with us! ⚓  

[i]- Mourning Tide team[/i][/p]
